species.season: Open year-round (conch pots only, max 2 pots)
species.size: 5 inches along the axis or 3.0 inch diameter at the whorl
species.quote: Knobbed conch must measure at least 5 inches along the axis or have a minimum diameter at the whorl of 3.0 inches. Conch (channeled and knobbed whelk) may only be taken using conch pots with at least one escape vent measuring at least 5 inches x 10 inches in the top or parlor section. The recreational harvest of conch by any other method is prohibited. Recreational conch potters may not use, place, set or tend more than two conch pots.
species.notes: Pots must carry all-white buoys with the owner's name and address and be tended at least every 72 hours.

species.season: Open year-round (conch pots only, max 2 pots)
species.size: 6 inches along the axis or 3.125 inch diameter at the whorl
species.quote: Channeled whelk must measure at least 6 inches along the axis or have a minimum diameter at the whorl of 3.125 (3 1/8) inches. Conch may only be taken using conch pots; recreational conch potters may not use more than two conch pots.
species.notes: Pots must carry all-white buoys with the owner's name and address and be tended at least every 72 hours.

species.quote: It is unlawful to recreationally harvest oysters in Delaware. This prohibition protects vulnerable oyster populations.
